sources.title: Entrepreneurship as Experimentation
sources.claim: Success probabilities are low, highly skewed, and unknowable until investment.

sources.title: Experimentation and Start-up Performance: Evidence from A/B Testing
sources.claim: Lower-cost testing was associated with 30 to 100 percent better performance after a year in an event-study design.

sources.title: A Scientific Approach to Entrepreneurial Decision Making
sources.claim: A randomized trial of 116 Italian startups found better performance, more pivots, and no higher early-stage dropout.
